# SEO Dominican Republic

> SEO Dominican Republic (seodominicanrepublic.com) helps businesses in the Dominican Republic get found on Google, in Google Maps and in AI answers. The site is bilingual (English and Spanish via an on-page toggle). It covers tourism, real estate, hospitality and local service businesses across the country's provinces.

## Pages
- [Home](https://seodominicanrepublic.com/): SEO, AI search optimization (AIO), local SEO and Google Business Profile work for Dominican Republic businesses, with service areas by province and an FAQ
- [¿Cuánto cuesta el SEO en República Dominicana?](https://seodominicanrepublic.com/cuanto-cuesta-el-seo-en-republica-dominicana/): precios publicados por agencias dominicanas en 2026, ITBIS y cómo comparar cotizaciones (español)
- [How much does SEO cost in the Dominican Republic?](https://seodominicanrepublic.com/seo-cost-dominican-republic/): published 2026 SEO prices from Dominican agencies, ITBIS and how to compare quotes (English)

## Related sites in the Dominican Republic
- [Santo Domingo SEO](https://santodomingoseo.com/): Santo Domingo businesses
- [Puerto Plata SEO](https://puertoplataseo.com/): Puerto Plata, Sosúa and Cabarete businesses

## Key facts
- Run by Eye To Ad Media, a digital marketing agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, in business since 2012
- No ranking guarantees; clients own their domain, website, Google Business Profile and ad accounts
